analyst_view.overall: Two struggling sides meet in Guimarães on Saturday night. Tiago Margarido's Vitória (14th, 9 points) went out of the Taça 0-2 at home to Braga, and A Bola calls the next three games against lower-table sides (Estrela, Estoril, Alverca) 'do or die'. Their defence has been hit this week: centre-back Toni Borevkovic is suspended after his fifth booking, and left-back João Mendes tore a cruciate ligament (out for the season), which with Francisco Dias also injured leaves Margarido without both his left-backs, so a B-team player (Kebdani or Tomás Rodrigues) is likely to start; the numbers list Dias but not Borevkovic or Mendes. Pepa's Estrela (12th, 10 points) have lost five league games in a row but won 1-0 at Portimonense in the cup; one report says Eddy Doué and Bénito remain suspended, which I could not confirm. Cláudio Pereira referees; the numbers have not used his record yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals, 1.7 for Vitória and 0.9 for Estrela. Vitória's back line has lost Borevkovic (suspended) and João Mendes (season over), neither of which the numbers know, so a defence that had tightened up will have a new centre-back and a reserve left-back, which should help Estrela's attack. One report has two Estrela regulars suspended, which keeps the lean small: about 2.8.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, 5.9 for Vitória. As the home side needing a win Vitória should push forward, but with a reserve left-back they may get less from that flank; both sides' recent corner counts are close to normal and already in the numbers, so I stay at about 9.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.9 cards. Vitória are under pressure and Margarido asked for more aggression after the Braga game, but they lose Borevkovic, who has already reached five bookings, while Estrela have been booked less than usual lately, which the numbers already take off. Cláudio Pereira referees and his record is not yet in the numbers, so I stay at about 4.9.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.7 shots, 14.9 for Vitória. Vitória had one shot in the first half against Braga but pressed hard after the break, and Estrela have been shooting more than expected lately, which the numbers already count. The defensive changes matter more for goals than for the shot count, so I stay at about 24.7.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.6 shots on target, 4.8 for Vitória. Estrela's accuracy has dropped during their losing run and the numbers already trim them for it; Vitória's makeshift defence could give Estrela a little more, but I have put that on goals and do not count it twice, so I stay at about 7.6.
